form.label: NetApp ONTAP EMS - Overview
form.description: Fixture-backed onboarding and first-triage dashboard for NetApp ONTAP EMS legacy syslog smoke events. This is not replay/read-back validation.

search.query: index=infraops sourcetype="ontap:ems" host=$host_tok$ (severity="$severity_tok$" OR "$severity_tok$"="*") | stats count
index=infraops sourcetype="ontap:ems" host=$host_tok$ (severity="$severity_tok$" OR "$severity_tok$"="*") severity IN (Error,ERROR,error,Critical,CRITICAL,Alert,ALERT) | stats count
index=infraops sourcetype="ontap:ems" host=$host_tok$ (severity="$severity_tok$" OR "$severity_tok$"="*") severity IN (Notice,NOTICE,Info,INFO,Informational,INFORMATIONAL) | stats count
index=infraops sourcetype="ontap:ems" host=$host_tok$ (severity="$severity_tok$" OR "$severity_tok$"="*") | stats dc(ontap_event_id)
index=infraops sourcetype="ontap:ems" host=$host_tok$ (severity="$severity_tok$" OR "$severity_tok$"="*") | timechart count
index=infraops sourcetype="ontap:ems" host=$host_tok$ (severity="$severity_tok$" OR "$severity_tok$"="*") | stats count by severity | sort -count

index=infraops sourcetype="ontap:ems" host=$host_tok$ (severity="$severity_tok$" OR "$severity_tok$"="*") | stats count, values(severity) as severities, values(signature) as signatures, values(ontap_sequence) as sequences by ontap_node, ontap_event_id | sort -count | head 50

index=infraops sourcetype="ontap:ems" host=$host_tok$ (severity="$severity_tok$" OR "$severity_tok$"="*") | table _time host source ontap_node ontap_event_id ontap_sequence severity signature signature_id marker | sort -_time | head 100

index=infraops sourcetype="ontap:ems" host=$host_tok$ (severity="$severity_tok$" OR "$severity_tok$"="*") | stats count, dc(ontap_event_id) as event_ids, values(severity) as severities, values(ontap_node) as ontap_nodes, values(vendor_product) as vendor_product by host, source, sourcetype | sort -count | head 100

index=infraops sourcetype="ontap:ems" host=$host_tok$ (severity="$severity_tok$" OR "$severity_tok$"="*") | table _time host source sourcetype vendor product vendor_product ontap_node ontap_event_id ontap_sequence severity signature signature_id marker _raw | sort -_time | head 100
